productBugs.symptom: The Portal Term type question lists its raw stored values as choices (fixed, auto_renew, evergreen) instead of labels such as Fixed and Evergreen; What you submitted also shows 'Term type fixed' and 'Value frequency one_time'.
productBugs.reproduction: Portal form /portal/new/doc_030_portal_evaluation_review_1790330794487, Term type options =Not set, fixed=fixed, auto_renew=auto_renew, evergreen=evergreen.
productBugs.effect: The guide's example says Fixed and Evergreen; a reader finds the lowercase values, so the step still works.

productBugs.symptom: With the built-in Department Row On intake form, the Portal form asks Department twice: the fixed Department basic (required) and a second Department question (optional, starts at Not set). The Request stores both. Conversion takes the second answer as the new Contract's Department and ignores the Department basic that Legal saw on the Request.
productBugs.reproduction: Sent departmentId=01a0d801-fa2c-76bc-81b4-c1a7a2783f18 and customFields.owning_department=01a0d801-fa39-7e8e-8cf7-5a47e0c20a2b. Portal What you submitted: "What you submitted Department Procurement Urgency Medium Description DOC-030 portal: two Department answers. Term type evergreen DOC-030 portal Business reason 1790330794487 DOC-030 portal: Department check. Department Engineering". Staff read: department "Procurement", customFields.owning_department "01a0d801-fa39-7e8e-8cf7-5a47e0c20a2b". Converted to C-338; its Department: "Engineering".
productBugs.effect: The guide says Department identifies the business team and that conversion carries it to the new record. Under this configuration the record gets the second answer instead.

productBugs.symptom: The Portal record Fields card draws "DOC-030 portal Fixed-term note 1790330794487: Not recorded" although that Row sits under the Term type is Fixed Branch and the record's Term type is Evergreen. This confirms the author's product bug (record-work.tsx calls no Form evaluator).
